messages:
Amy (CS): FYI — we've flagged 12 onboarding tenants hitting partial ingest + auth failures in eu-west-1. Customers are seeing stalled batch imports and 401/502 combos since ~11:10 UTC. Can we align on immediate external comms? :warning:
Jordan (SE): Investigating now. Initial signal shows token refresh race causing retries to cascade, then intermittent 502s from our IdP partner. Repro steps in logs: `POST /v1/onboard/import -> 401 -> refresh -> retry -> 502`. Ramp started 11:10, error rate peaked 11:25.
Leo (Eng): We're throttling retries and temporarily bypassing non-essential posthooks to reduce load. Patch queued, can push in 20m with rollback plan.
Sasha (PM): Need a customer-safe status update + estimated ETA. Also want to offer onboarding office hours for affected accounts and a one-time credit. Amy can you draft email?
Amy (CS): Draft below — please edit. Keeping short and empathetic.
---
Subject: Quick update on onboarding imports (eu-west-1) — action & next steps
Hi there,
We’re writing to let you know we’re addressing an issue affecting some onboarding imports in eu-west-1. You may see stalled imports or authentication errors. Our engineers identified a token refresh race combined with partner auth retries; a fix is deploying and we expect most imports to resume within 30–45 minutes.
What we’re doing: temporary retry throttling, bypassing non-essential webhooks, deploying a targeted patch.
If you’re impacted: reply to this thread or join our office hours at 12:30 UTC (link). We will also apply a one-time credit to affected tenants.
Apologies for the disruption — we’ll follow up with an RCA within 48 hours.
Best,
Amy on behalf of Redwood Inference Support
---
Jordan (SE): LGTM. Suggest small addition: note the mitigation window (start/expected finish) and an internal contact.
Amy (CS): Updated: added mitigation window and `support+onboard@redwood.ai` as contact.
Sasha (PM): I'll approve the customer note and add exec summary for AE/Sales. Amy — can you send segmented messages: 1) high-touch (enterprises) w/ phone + credits, 2) standard onboarding trials w/ office hours + credit note.
Amy (CS): Yep. I’ll prepare two drafts. Who can own the enterprise outreach? Need someone to brief AEs.
Leo (Eng): I can join a 15m AE sync once patch is live. 
Jordan (SE): Patch pushed to canary at 11:52 UTC. Observed error rate down 60% on canary. Rolling to eu-west-1 now. Monitoring.
CS Bot: Deploy 1761-canary -> eu-west-1 started by Jordan at 11:52 UTC.
Amy (CS): Sending standard batch at 12:05 UTC to affected trial tenants (email + in-app banner). Tagging list in the thread.
Sasha (PM): For renewal risk: flag any accounts with onboarding >72h stall. We should proactively engage CSMs for those. Amy — can you add a renewal-risk column in the impacted sheet?
Amy (CS): On it. Adding a column and a short rubric: >72h stalled OR manual imports failed x3 -> high renewal risk. Document link: https://redwood.internal/ops/onboard-incident-1761112223 (internal).
Leo (Eng): Full rollout finished at 11:58 UTC. Early metrics: ingest success rate up from 65% -> 95% on rolled hosts. Still monitoring residual 401s tied to partner IdP.
Jordan (SE): Next steps: (1) follow-up RCA (48h), (2) partner postmortem coordination, (3) long-term: increase jitter on refresh attempts + circuit breaker on IdP 502 spikes.
Amy (CS): Customer follow-ups scheduled: immediate note sent (12:05 UTC), enterprise handoff at 12:20 UTC, office hours 12:30 UTC. Will capture replies and surface any escalations.
Sasha (PM): Good. Also add a small customer survey after recovery to capture enablement friction for onboarding flows.
Amy (CS): Added survey ask to post-recovery email. Draft saved.
Jordan (SE): Logging note for RCA: token race + partner transient 502s -> mitigation: retry throttling + bypass hooks. Will create RCA outline and share in 24–48h.
Amy (CS): Thanks team. I’ll update this thread with any customer replies; please ping here with any infra changes. :thumbsup:
